summary: Applied plan-review r1 rulings F1 and F2 (commit fb1a640 in AnsibleSpecs). F1: the KubeCoder phase is removed, V14 records KubeCoder's manifest line as delivered before the run (KubeCoder 1e523e79, config.yaml:28), V23/V24 keep KubeCoder out of the slice's gates, and close-out A1 is noted. F2: P5 and V10 now require the Terraform to pass var.zfs_pools to the homelab provider block, since the attribute has no environment fallback (provider.go:261). The dry run parses 6 phases (P1-P5, P7).
